name: Love Me Tender ~Koyoi, Bar Alba de~
original_name: ラブミーテンダー ~今宵、Barアルバで~
source:
Yukihiko was playing the piano at Koichiro's bar as usual. Koichiro is Yukihiko's boyfriend and he is always kind to him. But one day, Yukihiko meets Ryosuke, his ex-boyfriend. Ryosuke tells him that he was looking for Yukihiko. Yukihiko was trying to forget Ryosuke, but he still remembers good memories of him. Even when Yukihiko sleeps with Koichiro, he thinks about Ryosuke.... Yukihiko, Koichiro, and Ryosuke. Who will Yukihiko choose or...?

[From Eroge Shop]
translation:
幸彦像往常一样在浩一郎的酒吧里弹钢琴。浩一郎是幸彦的男友，一直待他十分温柔。然而某天，幸彦遇见了前男友凉介。凉介告诉他，自己一直在寻找他。幸彦原本试图忘记凉介，却仍然记得两人共度的美好时光。即使与浩一郎同床时，他想起的依然是凉介……幸彦、浩一郎与凉介。幸彦最终会选择谁，还是说……？

[摘自Eroge Shop]
